summary: Lists three ways to apply conditions to roles: when under the roles keyword, when on a static import_role (both apply to all tasks), or conditions on individual tasks/blocks with dynamic include_role. Shows a role applied only on Debian.
questions: How do I apply a role only to Debian hosts?
Can I skip some tasks in a role based on a condition?
What's the difference between when on roles and on include_role?

answer_card.title: Conditionals with roles
answer_card.answer_md:
1. `when` under the **`roles`** keyword: added to every task in the role.
2. `when` on a static **`import_role`**: same, every task.
3. Conditions on individual tasks/blocks inside the role, with dynamic **`include_role`**: the only way to select or skip some tasks within the role.

```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  roles:
    - role: debian_stock_config
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
```
